title: Group holding CIC BIM Competition 2019 banner on outdoor pedestrian bridge
objects_and_counts: Seven people are standing in a roughly horizontal line in the central foreground of the image; all seven are holding a single long horizontal banner. None of the people are pictured on posters or screens; they are present in the photographed scene.
One large rectangular banner is held by the group across the lower third of the image; the banner occupies the central foreground and is partially obscured by the hands of the holders.

A multi-segment metal tubular bridge structure (visible in the mid- and background) spans the right side and extends toward the left background; multiple repeating curved metal tubes and cross-members form its visible framework.
One metal handrail/guardrail runs horizontally behind the group at waist-to-chest height across the mid-ground.
Two circular recessed features are visible in the paved ground surface in the foreground: one larger circular grate or plate near the image center and one smaller circular disc to the right of it.
Several distant buildings are visible in the far-left background; counts are not provided because they are partially occluded and distant.
One large Ferris-wheel-like structure is visible in the background behind the bridge framework (count = 1).
